title: Freeze independent exact Azure evidence-capture contract superseding unmerged 16A2

supersedes.reason: 16A2 mixed live capture implementation with contract constants shared into the verifier. 16A3 freezes an independent data-only capture contract; a bounded replacement slice implements capture by loading this spec.

g09_semantics.note: Corrected G09 budget-vs-anomaly semantics from unmerged 16A2 are preserved here for the next ledger remediation; merged 16A historical artifacts retain legacy naming until a ledger slice rewrites them.

frozen_method_attempt_semantics.method_binding: Each method_id binds exact command_template and/or REST method/path_template/api_version/body_schema, plus allowed subscription/RGs/hosts, retry_policy, and fallback_policy.
frozen_method_attempt_semantics.attempt_rule: One attempt-log record per physical dispatch including failures, retries, and declared fallback steps. Hidden retries/fallbacks and missing failure records are defects.
frozen_method_attempt_semantics.hash_rule: response_sha256 and complete_manifest_sha256 are independently recomputable from sanitized fixtures via frozen canonical JSON + SHA-256.

may_consume: Node crypto/fs/path/child_process only for offline checks
verifier_independence.must_not_share_constants_with_implementa: Implementation must load method IDs/paths/versions/retry/fallback from slice16a3-method-spec.json; verifier and implementation must not hardcode divergent copies.

acceptance_minimum: Refuse out-of-spec dispatch before physical call
Record one attempt log row per physical attempt including failures
Declare and record every fallback step
Write sanitized raw response artifacts with recomputable hashes
Emit complete_manifest_sha256 matching frozen method-spec hashable projection
bounded_replacement_implementation_owner.basis: clean master after 16A3 merge; do not use deferred 16A2 branch as ancestry

out_of_scope: live Azure / network / DB / Stripe / WhatsApp calls
rewriting merged 16A gate-matrix verdicts in this slice
implementing capture CLI/lib in this slice
Staff API / Hermes / database / Bicep edits

zero_mutation_proof.note: 16A3 may only add/update capture-contract docs/fixtures/verifier/npm script
